executive_summary.conclusion: Framework's public text pages clearly describe its modular laptops and desktops, repairability, Linux support, and configuration paths. Static collection from the host was blocked by HTTP 403, so this review uses public text fetch observations for answerability and routes; rendered behavior, independent corroboration breadth, and actual assistant visibility remain unmeasured.

not_checked: Rendered extraction and interactive engagement: browser automation is prohibited for this audit.
Keyboard, focus, mobile layout, overlays, performance, and context retention: browser automation is prohibited.
Static collector HTML pages: frame.work/ and sitemap.xml returned HTTP 403 to the bundled collector; public text fetch provided page excerpts instead.
Actual AI citations, provider IP access, Search Console settings, and behavioral analytics were not measured.

proactive_opportunities.title: Surface pre-order timing beside configuration CTAs
proactive_opportunities.rationale: The public configurator exposes material availability information, including a $1,199 starting pre-order and batch timing with sold-out labels, while the home page's primary Configure now links do not include that constraint in their surrounding copy.
proactive_opportunities.mechanism: Add a concise availability/pre-order note or linked shipping-status summary adjacent to major Configure now CTAs, preserving the live configurator as the source of truth.
proactive_opportunities.verification: From the home page and Laptop 13 Pro page, confirm that a visitor can see or reach current pre-order timing before entering configuration, and verify the note matches the configurator's current batch state.

readiness.detail: The bundled collector received HTTP 403 for robots.txt and the home page; the 4xx robots response is treated as unavailable rather than a site defect. A public text fetch opened the supplied page and task destinations.
Public text fetch exposed readable headings, product facts, qualifiers, navigation labels, and configuration content for the sampled pages; source HTML fields and rendered DOM were unavailable.
Three representative buyer questions were checked against the home page, product detail page, and configurator excerpts.

Independent review search results were opened as off-site leads for repairability and price context; no material contradiction with the sampled first-party product description was retained as a finding.
Source routes and public destination text were inspected, but interactive link activation, controls, choice retention, and rendered task completion were not checked under the no-browser constraint.
